name: Dale Milford
summary:
Dale Milford (February 18, 1926 – December 26, 1997) was a U.S. representative from Texas.
He was born in Bug Tussle, Texas, and attended its public schools, then Baylor University in Waco from 1953 to 1957. He served in the United States Army from 1944 to 1953, attaining the rank of captain.
